Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one landscape 3:2 professional architectural photograph for an Estonian premium interior door installation website. Door is muted warm grey-green, with two restrained recessed rectangular panels and a simple satin brass lever handle on a round rose near the RIGHT edge; three realistic small brass hinges on the LEFT edge. Camera nearly straight on at handle height using a natural 50mm architectural perspective, door and frame centered; entire frame and threshold visible with sufficient breathing room. Clean matching painted casing, understated warm ivory plaster walls, a small glimpse of honey oak parquet, soft diffuse daylight from outside the frame. Photorealistic premium craftsmanship, subtle painted wood texture, exact straight vertical frame, convincing human-scale construction. No elaborate palace ornament, no furniture obscuring edges.
